name: Cashback
author: Ben
summary: A bonus strain: expiring gambits pay their sell value.
description:
Pick Cashback in the blue bonus column on the Mod Strains page before a Custom run. It adds no heat and pays a gambit's sell value when the game's Gambit Expiry strain makes it expire. With expiry off, it has no effect.

Includes Collector's accumulated value and Boss Tooth's current value. Gambits disappear at their usual time; cashback does not trigger sale-only effects. Requires Strain Creation API 1.1.0 or newer.
